title: Crafters Book Actions
description: Take control of written books. Adds dates and signatures. Great for contracts and roleplay!
body:
![Banner](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/cda47e6dc27b1d909c3d723cf2672170356c247b_0.webp)

<iframe width="560" height="315" src="https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/ofeEZdo4VKA" title="YouTube video player" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" allowfullscreen></iframe>

This simple plugin adds more functionality and features to signed books in Minecraft. In it's current state there isn't a lot of things you can do yet, but updates are planned. This is only the initial release.

## > Usage
When signing or doing edits to a book it will state the last edited date and the signed on date.

To sign a book simply have an original copy of a written book in your main hand and run the command /signbook. It will then add, in italics, "Signed by" followed by the command executors in-game username.

Multiple players can sign the same book. There is currently no limit on the amount of players that can sign. An optional setting in the config is planned to allow this to be changed in the next version.

Webhook settings can be accessed via the config.

## > Commands
/signbook - original/copies of original books

/arwydd - adds lore signature, grey, to items in hand

/arwydd special - Adds lore signature, yellow, to item in hand

## > Permissions
craftersbookactions.sign

craftersbookactions.arwydd

craftersbookactions.reload

## > Config.yml


```
# Hey you! Thanks for using my plugin. I created it for my favorite server https://crafters.one.
# It's a small whitelisted vanilla SMP with a permanent map, generated on jan 28th, 2021.

# You can join us at https://crafters.one/Discord or see my other plugins here https://www.spigotmc.org/resources/authors/plexiate.117947/
# or at my modrinth here https://modrinth.com/user/Plexiate

webhook:
webhook-enabled: false

special-signers:
  plexiate: "EMOJI_OR_TITLE"
  randomwebuser: "EMOJI_OR_TITLE"

```
